info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the entire import/export process and practice in international trade. The topics mainly include significant elements of conducting an export/import business : Distribution channels, pricing the international trade, international sales contracts, trade document and transportation, method of payment, export regulation and tax incentives, import procedure and technique, problem and solution for international logistic, risk and insurance.

The course will incorporate AI tools for class discussions/critical thinking in activities on the Edunext platform; as well as utilize AI to solve assignments and establish group work ideas for the Group Assignment.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate the importance of international trade to the Global Economy and the impact of international and regional agreement on trade
Distinguish the term of sales (Incoterm)
Explain and analyze the export contract and major clauses in export contracts
Classify the factors behind the move toward harmonization of International contract/Commercial Law
Demonstate the documents frequently used in export- import transactions
Explain the role and function of freight forwarders and distinguish among air freight, ocean freight and land transport.
Interprete and discuss different methods of payment in international trade (consigment sales, open-account sales, documentary draft, L/C, cash in advance)
Explain the origins, benefits, theories and forms of countertrade
Define and understand regulations and policies affecting exports
Analyze the methods of levying the tariffs and import restrictions via non-tariff barriers
Explain the role of WTO, FTA, APEC in trade and functions of trade intermediaries and serivces such as customs brokers, free-trade zones and bonded warehoses.
Identify the determinants of trade, trade voume and direction
Examine the criterias to find, assess and select import products and suppliers
Demonstate the import and export process, rules of origin and other marking offers and requirements
Demonstrate ethical awareness in business context
Demonstrate how to assess and select the trading products based on systematic approach and reactive approach
Clarify the necesity of conducting international market research in term of making business decision and steps in international market assessment
Identify and explain the export channels of distribution as well as determinants of channel selection to market products abroad
Analyze major clauses in represenation agreement
Demonstrate the concept and steps of international logistic process and identify the external factors infulence on international logistic decisions
Identify the potential risks in foreign trade and understand the principles of insurance, terms of policy, claims and procedures
Clarify the export pricing objective and identify the derminants of export prices
